header.name: Move Inventory Web
header.description: Used by the Move Inventory screen when the "Submit" button is pressed.

data.messageTransform: $state.context.INFO.moveResults.message

"The scanned inventory has a handling unit. Moving this inventory will remove it from the handling unit. To remove it from the handling unit and proceed with the move, press \"confirm\". To move the handling unit and all its inventory instead, press \"decline\" and scan the handling unit instead."
"When moved, inventory is taken out of its handling unit. To move the handling unit, you must scan the handling unit directly."

"Multiple Inventory and/or Handling Units were found with the scanned barcode. This is usually the sign of a mistake in the data. Contact your supervisor or administrator about this error to ensure more like it don't occur.\n"
& 'Scanned Barcode: ' & $state.context.INPUT.scannedBarcode & '\n'
& 'Matching Inventory Ids: ' & $join([$state.context.INFO.inventory.id], ", ") & '\n'
& 'Matching Handling Unit Ids: ' & $join([$state.context.INFO.handlingUnit.id], ", ")

'The scanned inventory record was found to be "inactive", meaning that it was soft-deleted and is no longer valid for use. Talk to your administrator or supervisor if you believe this to be a mistake.'
'Inventory / Handling Unit not found. The scanned barcode "' & $string($state.context.INPUT.scannedBarcode) & '" did not return any results from the database.'
'The scanned handling unit was found to be "inactive", meaning that it was soft-deleted and is no longer valid for use. Talk to your administrator or supervisor if you believe this to be a mistake.'

"The scanned handling unit has a parent handling unit. Moving this handling unit will move all handling units that share a handling unit with this one. To proceed with the move, press \"confirm\". To move only the scanned handling unit, press \"decline\" and go to the Handling Unit Assemble screen."
"When moved, a handling unit is taken out of its parent handling unit. To move the parent, you must scan the parent directly.."

data.valueTransform:
$count(productPreferredStorageUnit.edges) = 1?
  "Area " & $.**.area.code & ", Zone " & $.**.storageZone.code & ", Unit " & $.**.storageUnit.code
  
  :
  "No storage unit to suggest."
